messages:
maya (marketing): Quick sync 10am PT announce target for Beta feature. Need: final changelog link, docs anchor, webinar window (30m), short bench blurb, and lead routing. Can eng confirm canary timing and changelog pointer?

eli (eng): Canary plan OK. Start 8:45am PT 25% for 10m, then 100% if stable. Draft changelog at https://redwood.dev/changelog/beta-2024 (WIP).

nina (docs): Docs draft at https://docs.redwood.dev/beta. Added quickstart with curl + node snippets; will shorten examples for the announcement. Point to docs#quickstart anchor.

sam (product): Suggested hero line: "Beta: predictable, low-cost inference at production scale." Webinar CTA: "Register for a live demo and perf breakdown."

kara (sales): Routing: tag webinar signups with lead.source:beta_webinar and route to SF AE queue. I'll wire Intercom once tags confirmed. Also add nurture for Dedicated interest.

eli (eng): Changelog updated with rollback steps: https://redwood.dev/changelog/beta-2024. Ops snippet:

```
rollout:
  mode: canary
  percent: 25
  watch: 10m
  promote_on: stable
  fallback: previous-release
```

Auto-fallback if p95 > 350ms for >2m.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by eli for 2024-06-20T08:45:00-07:00. CI green. :rocket: 

nina (docs): Published trimmed quickstart at https://docs.redwood.dev/beta#quickstart. Use that link in the post.

maya (marketing): Kara please add the Intercom rule and confirm. Sam, can you pick 2 headline variants by EOD?

sam (product): Short: "Redwood Beta: faster, predictable inference". Long: "Redwood Beta: unified inference with canary rollouts and observability across deployments". Dropping into draft.

kara (sales): Intercom rule added and validated. Leads appear in SF with tag beta_webinar. Dedicated interest labeled.

eli (eng): Canary started on schedule. Early perf: p50 110ms, p95 260ms. Monitoring.

maya (marketing): Bench blurb: "Beta reduces median latency by ~25% and p95 by ~15% vs baseline due to batching and KV-cache improvements. See webinar for details." Keep it to one short paragraph. Publishing target 10:05am PT after canary steady. Everyone good? :thumbsup:

eli (eng): :thumbsup:

nina (docs): :thumbsup:

sam (product): :thumbsup:

kara (sales): :thumbsup:

maya (marketing): Will post final announce copy 30m before publish for quick review.
